stem: The Articles of Confederation allowed each state only one vote in Congress. Which question reflects a major concern states had about this arrangement?

options.label: F
options.text: Should states attempt to resolve conflicting claims to territory?

options.label: G
options.text: Should states change their procedure for selecting representatives?

options.label: H
options.text: Should unanimous state approval for national laws be required?

options.label: J
options.text: Should more populous states receive greater representation?
